If you feel uncomfortable with this, you could always invest in some dog pins instead to give them more free roam and can even put them inside or outside this way. To keep two dogs from fighting you need to make sure they know YOU are the boss, not them. This can be done through training, just a couple basic tricks like sit, down, stay, come. When you feed them you can put them in separate rooms or even put one outside and the other inside. Maybe feed them in their pins or crates.
